title: We’ve evaluated Gemini 4 Neon on FrontierCode 2.0, our benchmark that measures whether you should me...
text: We’ve evaluated Gemini 4 Neon on FrontierCode 2.0, our benchmark that measures whether you should merge the PR, and found that it scores within one point of Opus 5.5 at about a third of the cost. It is the strongest of the Gemini model series with a score of 46.2% and a cost of $4.38 per task. Gemini 4 Neon is now available to use in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI! 💬82🔄84❤️1119👀115822📊210 ⚡ Powered by xgo.ing
